I've been suggesting a purchasing scheme that can be used to thwart the downvote brigades as well as reduce the amount of "throw away" accounts created and instill an ownership mentality over a single account that a user has invested in making better.

  1. Offer all add-ons, e.g, links open in new window, message a member directly, dark skin, tagging members, etc. for purchase to add-on to your account - not to be shared across your many accounts; each will have to purchase their own add-on. This helps support the growth and cost of the development and at the same time allows for a more invested user.

  2. All subverse are to be purchased and rent is to be paid based on activity; the fewer active users the more expensive the rent, the greater the activity the less the cost up to no cost if it is a featured/default sub.

  3. Until an account has a predetermined amount of "karma" downvotes must be purchased in packages. This limits the amount of downvotes being thrown around and absolutely stifles downvote brigades. Again, a person will not want to purchase multiple packages for multiple accounts to swam and cause harm. Each downvote can cost about a penny, but once that account has reached the karma limit they are released from having to purchase the downvotes. Also, for every 10 upvotes given a downvote is earned. So you don't have to always purchase your downvotes, but you'll have to do a serious amount of upvoting to gain any real downvote traction.

  4. Whoaverse should remain open to enrollment but invite only restricted for subverse creation starting now! In fact, a person should have to earn the ability to gain a subverse if we don't go with the renting option.

I have some other ideas that I'll save for another post. Tell me what you think about these ideas and what we can do now to thwart the influx of account name grabbers, sub-squatters and reddit heathens.
